title: Gipotetik shart gaplar: would, were va wish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida second conditional bilan xayoliy vaziyatlarni tasvirlaysiz, If I were you bilan maslahat berasiz va wish yordamida hozirgi istak hamda afsuslarni ifodalaysiz.

scenes.title: Gipotetik shart gaplar
board: Lesson: Hypothetical conditionals
(Xayoliy shart gaplar)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda real shart gaplarni o‘rgandik: “If it rains, we’ll stay in.” Bugun esa haqiqatga to‘g‘ri kelmaydigan yoki ehtimoli juda kam vaziyatlar haqida gapiramiz: “Agar millionerim bo‘lsam, dunyo bo‘ylab sayohat qilgan bo‘lardim.” Dars oxirida second conditional, “If I were you” bilan maslahat va “wish” iborasini erkin ishlata olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we talked about real conditions. Today we imagine things that are not true now, or are very unlikely. By the end, you will talk about dreams, give advice and express wishes.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar real shartlar haqida gaplashdik. Bugun hozir to‘g‘ri bo‘lmagan yoki juda ehtimoldan yiroq narsalarni tasavvur qilamiz. Dars oxirida orzular haqida gapirasiz, maslahat berasiz va istaklaringizni bildirasiz.

scenes.title: Real va xayoliy vaziyat
board: Real: If I win, I'll buy a car.
Unreal: If I won, I'd buy a car.
Past form = distance from reality

examples.t: If I win the lottery, I'll buy a house.
If I won the lottery, I would buy an island.
examples.uz: Lotereyada yutib olsam edi, orol sotib olardim.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi gapda gapiruvchi yutish ehtimolini real deb biladi. Ikkinchi gapda esa vaziyat xayoliy yoki juda ehtimoldan yiroq. Inglizcha buni zamon bilan ko‘rsatadi: haqiqatdan uzoqlashganimiz sari fe’l bir pog‘ona o‘tmishga siljiydi. Shuning uchun “won” — bu o‘tmish emas, bu xayol belgisi. Gap hozir yoki kelajak haqida ketyapti. Bu mavzuning eng muhim g‘oyasi: o‘tmish shakli, lekin hozirgi ma’no.
scenes.say: In the first sentence, winning feels possible. In the second, it is imaginary or very unlikely. English shows this with a past form, but the meaning is about now or the future, not the past.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi gapda yutish mumkin tuyuladi. Ikkinchisida u xayoliy yoki juda dargumon. Inglizcha buni o‘tmish shakli bilan bildiradi, lekin ma’no hozir yoki kelajak haqida, o‘tmish haqida emas.

scenes.title: Second conditional tuzilishi
board: If + Past Simple, would + V1
If I had more time, I would travel more.
If she lived here, we'd see her.

examples.t: If I had more time, I would learn Spanish.
examples.uz: Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa edi, ispan tilini o‘rgangan bo‘lardim.

examples.t: If we lived by the sea, we'd swim every day.
examples.uz: Dengiz bo‘yida yashasak edi, har kuni cho‘milgan bo‘lardik.

scenes.say_native: Second conditional, ya’ni ikkinchi shart gap, mana bunday tuziladi: shart qismida Past Simple, natija qismida “would” va fe’lning asosiy shakli. Qisqartma — “’d”: “I’d”, “we’d”. Past Simple bu yerda o‘tmishni emas, xayoliy hozirni bildiradi. “If I had more time” — hozir vaqtim yo‘q. O‘zbekchada bunga “-sa edi” va “-gan bo‘lardim” shakllari to‘g‘ri keladi, ya’ni biz allaqachon bunday ma’noni bilamiz.
scenes.say: If I had more time, I would learn Spanish. If we lived by the sea, we'd swim every day. She would be happier if she had a dog.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa, ispan tilini o‘rgangan bo‘lardim. Dengiz bo‘yida yashasak, har kuni cho‘milardik. Iti bo‘lsa, u baxtliroq bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Orzular va tasavvur
board: If I were rich, I'd help children.
If I could fly, I'd visit Japan.
What would you do if you were invisible?

examples.t: If I were rich, I'd build a school.
If I could fly, I would visit Japan.

scenes.say_native: Mana tipik misollar. Boy bo‘lsam, nima qilgan bo‘lardim? Uchishni bilsam, qayerga borardim? Bu savollar o‘yin kabi, ular suhbatni qiziqarli qiladi. Bir qoida: “would” faqat natija qismida turadi, shart qismida Past Simple yoki “could” bo‘ladi. Ingliz tilida ko‘pincha “What would you do if...?” deb so‘rashadi, javobda esa “I’d...” deyiladi. Bu kundalik suhbatning sevimli mavzusi.
scenes.say: If I were rich, I'd build a school. If I could fly, I would visit Japan. What would you do if you were invisible? I'd walk into a cinema for free!
scenes.say_uz: Boy bo‘lsam, maktab qurardim. Uchishni bilsam, Yaponiyaga borardim. Ko‘rinmas bo‘lsangiz, nima qilardingiz? Kinoga tekin kirardim!

scenes.title: If I were: barcha shaxslar bilan
board: If I were / he were / she were / it were
Informal: If I was...
If it were easy, everyone would do it.

examples.t: If he were here, he would help us.
examples.uz: U shu yerda bo‘lsa, bizga yordam bergan bo‘lardi.

examples.t: If I were you, I'd say yes.

scenes.say_native: “Be” fe’li bilan alohida qoida bor. Xayoliy shartda “were” hamma shaxslar uchun ishlatiladi: “if I were”, “if he were”, “if she were”, “if it were”. Qoidaga ko‘ra “if I was” noto‘g‘ri, lekin og‘zaki nutqda ko‘p odamlar “if I was” deydi, va bu keng tarqalgan. Imtihonda va yozma ishda “were” dan foydalaning, shunda xato qilmaysiz. “If I were you” — qotib qolgan ibora, uni doim “were” bilan ayting.
scenes.say: If he were here, he would help us. If it were easier, more people would try. If I were you, I'd say yes. Careful: in speech, you may hear if I was, but if I were is safer.
scenes.say_uz: U shu yerda bo‘lsa, bizga yordam berardi. Osonroq bo‘lsa, ko‘proq odam urinib ko‘rardi. Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, rozi bo‘lardim. Og‘zaki nutqda if I was ham eshitiladi, lekin if I were xavfsizroq.

scenes.title: Inkor va savol
board: wouldn't = would not
What would you do if you lost your job?
Would you move abroad if you got an offer?

examples.t: I wouldn't tell anyone if I were you.
examples.uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, hech kimga aytmasdim.

examples.t: Would you move abroad if you got a good offer?
examples.uz: Yaxshi taklif olsangiz, chet elga ko‘chib o‘tarmidingiz?

scenes.say_native: Inkor shakli oddiy: “wouldn’t” plus fe’l. Savolda esa “would” gap boshiga chiqadi: “Would you move abroad?” Ochiq savol uchun so‘roq so‘zi qo‘shiladi: “What would you do if you lost your job?” Qisqa javoblar: “Yes, I would” va “No, I wouldn’t”. Esda tuting: javobda “would” ning o‘zi yetadi, fe’lni takrorlamaysiz. O‘zbekchada bunday savollarni “-armidingiz?” bilan beramiz.
scenes.say: Would you move abroad if you got a good offer? Yes, I would. No, I wouldn't. What would you do if you lost your job? I wouldn't panic.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi taklif olsangiz, chet elga ko‘chib o‘tarmidingiz? Ha, ko‘chardim. Yo‘q, ko‘chmasdim. Ishdan ayrilsangiz, nima qilardingiz? Vahimaga tushmasdim.

scenes.title: Would shart qismida emas
board: ✗ If I would have money, I would travel.
✓ If I had money, I would travel.
✗ If I will be rich, ... ✗ If I would be rich, ...
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — “if” dan keyin ham “would” qo‘yish: “If I would have money.” O‘zbekchada “bo‘lsa edi” va “bo‘lardim” ikkalasi ham xayoliy ma’noni bildiradi, shuning uchun ikkalasiga ham alohida so‘z qo‘ygingiz keladi. Inglizchada esa shart qismida faqat Past Simple bo‘ladi, “would” faqat natija qismiga tegishli. To‘g‘risi: “If I had money, I would travel.” Real shartdagi qoida shu yerda ham ishlaydi: “if” dan keyin modal yo‘q.
scenes.say: Not: If I would have money. Say: If I had money, I would travel. The if clause uses the past simple. Would belongs in the result clause.
scenes.say_uz: “If I would have money” emas. Ayting: Pulim bo‘lsa, sayohat qilardim. Shart qismida Past Simple, would esa natija qismida.

scenes.title: Gaplarni tugating
board: 1) If I had a car, I ...
2) If she lived in London, she ...
3) If we didn't have school, we ...
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni xayoliy tarzda davom ettiring. Natija qismida “would” va fe’lning asosiy shaklini ishlating. Birinchisi: mashinangiz bo‘lsa, nima qilasiz? Ikkinchisi: u Londonda yashasa, nima qiladi? Uchinchisi: maktab bo‘lmasa, nima qilamiz? Aniq to‘g‘ri javob yo‘q, har qanday mantiqiy javob bo‘ladi. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Finish the sentences with would. If I had a car, I... If she lived in London, she... If we didn't have school, we...
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni would bilan tugating. Mashinam bo‘lsa, men... U Londonda yashasa, u... Maktab bo‘lmasa, biz...

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) ... I would drive to the mountains.
2) ... she would visit the museums.
3) ... we would sleep late.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: “If I had a car, I would drive to the mountains.” Ikkinchi: “If she lived in London, she would visit the museums.” Uchinchi: “If we didn’t have school, we would sleep late.” Sizning javoblaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin va bu yaxshi. Tekshiring: shart qismida Past Simple, natijada “would” va fe’l bor edimi? Agar shunday bo‘lsa, siz topshiriqni to‘g‘ri bajardingiz.
scenes.say: If I had a car, I would drive to the mountains. If she lived in London, she would visit the museums. If we didn't have school, we would sleep late.
scenes.say_uz: Mashinam bo‘lsa, tog‘larga haydab borardim. U Londonda yashasa, muzeylarni ko‘rardi. Maktab bo‘lmasa, kech turib uxlardik.

scenes.title: Real shartdan farqi
board: Real: likely / possible → will
Unreal: unlikely / imaginary → would
If I see him, I'll ask. If I saw him, I'd ask.

examples.t: If I have time, I'll visit you.
If I had time, I would visit you.
examples.uz: Vaqtim bo‘lsa edi, sizni ko‘rgani borardim.

scenes.say_native: Ikki shart gapning farqi gapiruvchi vaziyatni qanday baholashiga bog‘liq. Vaqtingiz bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lsa — “If I have time, I’ll visit you.” Vaqt umuman yo‘q, bo‘lishi ehtimoldan yiroq bo‘lsa — “If I had time, I would visit you.” Ikkinchi gap odatda “aslida bora olmayman” degan ma’noni yashiradi. Ba’zan tanlov muloyimlik uchun ham qilinadi: ikkinchi shakl yumshoqroq va kamroq majbur qiluvchi eshitiladi.
scenes.say: If I have time, I'll visit you. That is possible. If I had time, I would visit you. That suggests I probably don't have time.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqtim bo‘lsa, sizni ko‘rgani boraman. Bu mumkin. Vaqtim bo‘lsa edi, sizni ko‘rgani borardim. Bu ehtimol vaqtim yo‘qligini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Tanlov xatosi
board: ✗ If I won the lottery tomorrow, ... (agar bilet olgan bo‘lsangiz)
✗ If I will be 80, I would ...
✓ If I'm 80, I'll ... / If I were 80, I'd ...
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik ikki shaklni aralashtiradi: yarim real, yarim xayoliy gap tuzadi. “If I have money, I would buy it” — shart real, natija xayoliy, bu mantiqsiz. Gap bir tomonga mos bo‘lsin: yo real juftlik — “have” plus “will”, yo xayoliy juftlik — “had” plus “would”. Ikkinchi xato: faqat o‘zingiz uchun tanlov qilmang. Suhbatdoshingiz real deb o‘ylasa, real shaklni ishlating. Ikkala qismni mos tanlash bu mavzuning kaliti.
scenes.say: Do not mix the pairs. Real: if I have money, I will buy it. Unreal: if I had money, I would buy it. Not: if I have money, I would buy it.
scenes.say_uz: Juftliklarni aralashtirmang. Real: pulim bo‘lsa, sotib olaman. Xayoliy: pulim bo‘lsa edi, sotib olardim. “If I have money, I would buy it” emas.

scenes.title: Real yoki xayoliy?
board: 1) If I (see / saw) a snake, I'd run away.
2) If it (is / were) sunny tomorrow, we'll go out.
3) What would you do if you (win / won) a million?
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Avval natija qismiga qarang: “would” bormi yoki “will” bormi? Shart qismi unga mos bo‘lishi kerak. Birinchisida “I’d run away”, ikkinchisida “we’ll go out”, uchinchisida “would you do”. Har bir to‘liq gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the correct form. If I see or saw a snake, I'd run away. If it is or were sunny tomorrow, we'll go out. What would you do if you win or won a million?
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Ilonni ko‘rsam, qochardim. Ertaga havo ochiq bo‘lsa, sayr qilamiz. Million yutsangiz, nima qilardingiz?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) saw
2) is
3) won
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “If I saw a snake, I’d run away” — “would” bor, demak shartda Past Simple. Ikkinchi: “If it is sunny tomorrow, we’ll go out” — “will” bor, shartda Present Simple, ob-havo esa haqiqatan yaxshi bo‘lishi mumkin. Uchinchi: “What would you do if you won a million?” — “would” va “won” juftligi. Qoida oddiy: will bilan present, would bilan past.
scenes.say: If I saw a snake, I'd run away. If it is sunny tomorrow, we'll go out. What would you do if you won a million?
scenes.say_uz: Ilon ko‘rsam, qochardim. Ertaga havo ochiq bo‘lsa, sayr qilamiz. Million yutsangiz, nima qilardingiz?

scenes.title: If I were you: maslahat
board: If I were you, I'd + V1
If I were you, I wouldn't + V1
Why don't you...? / You should...

examples.t: If I were you, I'd see a doctor.
If I were you, I wouldn't buy that phone.
examples.uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, u telefonni olmasdim.

scenes.say_native: Maslahat berishning eng mashhur usuli — “If I were you, I’d...” Siz go‘yo suhbatdoshingiz o‘rniga o‘zingizni qo‘yasiz va nima qilishingizni aytasiz. Bu “You should” ga qaraganda yumshoqroq eshitiladi, chunki buyruq ohangi yo‘q. O‘zbekchada “o‘rningizda bo‘lsam” deymiz, tuzilish deyarli bir xil. Inkor maslahat: “If I were you, I wouldn’t...” Qisqartirilgan variant — “I’d”. Eslang, bu yerda “were” doim qoladi.
scenes.say: If I were you, I'd see a doctor. If I were you, I wouldn't buy that phone. I'd talk to her first, if I were you.
scenes.say_uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, shifokorga borardim. Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, u telefonni olmasdim. Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, avval u bilan gaplashardim.

scenes.title: Maslahatdagi xatolar
board: ✗ If I am you, I will go.
✓ If I were you, I'd go.
✗ If I were you, I will go.
scenes.say_native: Maslahatda ikkita xato uchraydi. Birinchisi: “If I am you” deyish. Siz suhbatdosh emassiz, bu xayoliy vaziyat, shuning uchun “were” kerak. Ikkinchisi: natija qismida “will” qo‘yish. “If I were you, I will go” — ikki xil dunyoni aralashtirish. Natijada doim “would” turadi. Shunday qilib, ibora butunlay qat’iy: “If I were you, I’d” va keyin fe’l. Uni xuddi bitta so‘zdek yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Say: If I were you, I'd go. Not: If I am you, I will go. The phrase is fixed: if I were you, I'd plus a verb.
scenes.say_uz: Ayting: sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, borardim. “If I am you, I will go” demang. Ibora qat’iy: if I were you, I'd va fe’l.

scenes.title: Maslahat bering
board: 1) My head hurts all day.
2) I have an exam tomorrow and I'm nervous.
3) My neighbour plays loud music at night.
scenes.say_native: Uchta muammo bor. Har biriga “If I were you, I’d...” bilan maslahat bering. Birinchida boshingiz kun bo‘yi og‘riyapti. Ikkinchida ertaga imtihon va siz asabiylashyapsiz. Uchinchida qo‘shnining kechasi baland musiqasi bor. Har bir maslahat to‘liq gap bo‘lsin. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Give advice with If I were you. My head hurts all day. I have an exam tomorrow and I'm nervous. My neighbour plays loud music at night.
scenes.say_uz: If I were you bilan maslahat bering. Boshim kun bo‘yi og‘riydi. Ertaga imtihonim bor, asabiylashyapman. Qo‘shnim kechasi baland musiqa qo‘yadi.

scenes.title: Namuna maslahatlar
board: 1) If I were you, I'd drink more water.
2) If I were you, I'd go to bed early.
3) If I were you, I'd talk to him politely.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “If I were you, I’d drink more water and see a doctor.” Ikkinchi: “If I were you, I’d go to bed early and review the notes in the morning.” Uchinchi: “If I were you, I’d talk to him politely first.” Ko‘rdingizmi, maslahat aniq va foydali bo‘lishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, “I wouldn’t worry” kabi inkor maslahat ham juda tabiiy eshitiladi. Siz ham shunday qildingizmi?
scenes.say: If I were you, I'd drink more water. If I were you, I'd go to bed early. If I were you, I'd talk to him politely first.
scenes.say_uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, ko‘proq suv ichardim. Barvaqt yotardim. Avval u bilan odob bilan gaplashardim.

scenes.title: Wish: hozirgi istak
board: wish + Past Simple = hozirgi afsus
I wish I had a bigger flat.
I wish I knew the answer.

examples.t: I wish I had a bigger flat.
I wish I knew the answer.

scenes.say_native: “Wish” hozirgi vaziyatdan afsuslanishni bildiradi. Undan keyin Past Simple turadi, xuddi second conditional singari. “I wish I had a bigger flat” — hozir kvartiram kichik, katta bo‘lishini xohlardim. “I wish I knew the answer” — javobni bilmayman. O‘zbekchada bunga “-sa edi” shakli to‘g‘ri keladi: “bilsam edi”. Asosiy g‘oya bir xil: o‘tmish shakli, lekin ma’no hozirgi, haqiqatga zid.
scenes.say: I wish I had a bigger flat. I wish I knew the answer. She wishes she lived closer to work.
scenes.say_uz: Kvartiram kattaroq bo‘lsa edi. Javobni bilsam edi. U ishga yaqinroq yashasa edi, deb orzu qiladi.

scenes.title: Wish bilan were va could
board: I wish I were taller.
I wish I could swim.
I wish it weren't so cold.

examples.t: I wish I were taller.
I wish I could play the guitar.

scenes.say_native: “Be” fe’li bilan yana “were” ishlatiladi: “I wish I were taller”, “I wish it weren’t so cold”. Bu yerda ham og‘zaki nutqda “was” eshitiladi, lekin “were” to‘g‘rirog‘. Layoqat haqida afsuslanish uchun “could” ishlatamiz: “I wish I could play the guitar” — chala olmayman, chala olsam edi. “Wish” dan keyin “would” ham kelishi mumkin, lekin u boshqa ma’no beradi. Bu haqida keyingi qadamlarda gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: I wish I were taller. I wish it weren't so cold. I wish I could play the guitar. I wish I could speak French.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘yim uzunroq bo‘lsa edi. Havo bunchalik sovuq bo‘lmasa edi. Gitara chala olsam edi. Fransuzcha gapira olsam edi.

scenes.title: I wish ... would
board: I wish + person + would + V1
I wish you would stop talking.
Not for your own actions!

examples.t: I wish he would call me back.
examples.uz: U menga qaytib qo‘ng‘iroq qilsa edi.

examples.t: I wish it would stop raining.

scenes.say_native: “I wish someone would...” shikoyat yoki so‘rovni bildiradi: boshqa odam yoki narsaning xatti-harakati bizni bezovta qilyapti. “I wish he would call me back” — u qo‘ng‘iroq qilmayapti va men buni xohlayman. “I wish it would stop raining.” Muhim cheklov: o‘z harakatingiz uchun “I wish I would” deb bo‘lmaydi, u yerda “could” yoki Past Simple ishlating. Bu tuzilish keyingi darajalarda ham kerak bo‘ladi, hozircha tanishib chiqing.
scenes.say: I wish he would call me back. I wish it would stop raining. I wish my neighbours would be quieter.
scenes.say_uz: U menga qaytib qo‘ng‘iroq qilsa edi. Yomg‘ir to‘xtasa edi. Qo‘shnilarim biroz jimroq bo‘lsa edi.

scenes.title: Wish bilan zamon xatosi
board: ✗ I wish I have a car.
✓ I wish I had a car.
✗ I wish I will be taller. ✓ I wish I were taller.
scenes.say_native: Wish bilan eng katta xato — hozirgi zamon qo‘yish. “I wish I have a car” deganda ma’no buziladi, chunki o‘zbekchada “bo‘lsa edi” shaklini “bor” kabi tarjima qilamiz. Inglizchada istak haqiqatga zid bo‘lgani uchun Past Simple kerak: “I wish I had a car.” Ikkinchi xato: “will” ishlatish. “Wish” dan keyin kelasi zamon yo‘q, “were” yoki “could” ishlating. Uchinchi eslatma: “I wish I would” o‘z harakatingiz haqida ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: Say: I wish I had a car. Not: I wish I have a car. After wish, use the past: had, knew, were, could.
scenes.say_uz: Ayting: mashinam bo‘lsa edi. “I wish I have a car” demang. Wish dan keyin o‘tmish shakli: had, knew, were, could.

scenes.title: Istaklaringizni ayting
board: 1) I don't have a dog. → I wish ...
2) I can't drive a car. → I wish ...
3) It's very noisy here. → I wish ...
scenes.say_native: Uchta haqiqatni istakka aylantiring. Birinchi: itingiz yo‘q, uni xohlaysiz. Ikkinchi: mashina haydashni bilmaysiz, bilsangiz edi. Uchinchi: bu yer juda shovqinli, tinch bo‘lsa edi. Har birini “I wish” bilan boshlang va Past Simple, “could” yoki “were” ishlating.
scenes.say: Turn these facts into wishes. I don't have a dog. I can't drive. It's very noisy here.
scenes.say_uz: Bu faktlarni istakka aylantiring. Itim yo‘q. Mashina haydashni bilmayman. Bu yer juda shovqinli.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I wish I had a dog.
2) I wish I could drive.
3) I wish it weren't so noisy.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I wish I had a dog.” Ikkinchi: “I wish I could drive.” Uchinchi: “I wish it weren’t so noisy”, yoki “I wish it were quieter.” Hammasida Past Simple, “could” yoki “were” turibdi, hech qaysisida hozirgi zamon yo‘q. Agar to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, ajoyib. Bu bilan siz o‘z afsuslaringizni va orzularingizni ingliz tilida to‘g‘ri ifodalay olasiz.
scenes.say: I wish I had a dog. I wish I could drive. I wish it weren't so noisy. Or: I wish it were quieter.
scenes.say_uz: Itim bo‘lsa edi. Mashina haydashni bilsam edi. Bu yer bunchalik shovqinli bo‘lmasa edi. Yoki: tinchroq bo‘lsa edi.

scenes.title: Would, could, might
board: would = aniq natija
could = imkoniyat
might = balki

examples.t: If I had a bike, I could ride to work.
examples.uz: Velosipedim bo‘lsa, ishga minib borishim mumkin edi.

examples.t: If it were warmer, we might go swimming.
examples.uz: Havo issiqroq bo‘lsa, balki cho‘milgani borardik.

scenes.say_native: Natija qismida faqat “would” bo‘lishi shart emas. “Would” natijaga ishonch bilan aytilganda ishlatiladi. “Could” imkoniyat berganda: “I could ride to work” — minib borishim mumkin edi. “Might” esa noaniqlik bildiradi: “we might go swimming” — balki cho‘milgani boramiz. Shart qismida ham “could” bo‘lishi mumkin: “If I could sing” — qo‘shiq aytishni bilsam. Shu so‘zlar tanlovi sizning nutqingizni boyitadi.
scenes.say: If I had a bike, I could ride to work. If it were warmer, we might go swimming. If I could sing, I would join a band.
scenes.say_uz: Velosipedim bo‘lsa, ishga minib borishim mumkin edi. Havo issiqroq bo‘lsa, balki cho‘milgani borardik. Qo‘shiq aytishni bilsam, guruhga qo‘shilardim.

scenes.title: Tinglang: yangi ish taklifi
board: Dan: What would you do if you got the job in Dubai?
Lena: I'd take it, but I'd miss my family.
Dan: If I were you, I'd ask for a trial period.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Dan va Lena ish haqida gaplashadi. Lenaga Dubayda ish taklif qilinishi mumkin. Ular nima qilishi haqida xayol suradi. Dialogda second conditional, “If I were you” va “wish” borligiga e’tibor bering. Keyin savollarga javob beramiz.
scenes.say: Dan: What would you do if you got the job in Dubai? Lena: I'd take it, but I'd miss my family. I wish it were closer. Dan: If I were you, I'd ask for a trial period. Lena: Good idea. If they said yes, I could go for three months first.
scenes.say_uz: Dan: Dubaydagi ishni olsang, nima qilarding? Lena: Olardim, lekin oilamni sog‘inardim. Yaqinroq bo‘lsa edi. Dan: Sening o‘rningda bo‘lsam, sinov muddatini so‘rardim. Lena: Yaxshi fikr. Rozi bo‘lishsa, avval uch oyga borishim mumkin.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What would Lena do if she got the job?
2) What does Lena wish?
3) What advice does Dan give?
scenes.say_native: Dialogdan uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Lena ish olsa, nima qiladi? Ikkinchi: Lena nimani orzu qiladi? Uchinchi: Dan qanday maslahat beradi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting va mos shaklni ishlating: “would”, “wish” yoki “If I were you”. Savollar dialogning asosiy fikrlariga qaratilgan: qaror, orzu va maslahat.
scenes.say: Answer the questions. What would Lena do if she got the job? What does Lena wish? What advice does Dan give?
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Lena ishni olsa, nima qiladi? Lena nimani orzu qiladi? Dan qanday maslahat beradi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1) She would take it.
2) She wishes Dubai were closer.
3) He advises a trial period.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Lena ishni olgan bo‘lardi, lekin oilasini sog‘inardi. Ikkinchi: u Dubay yaqinroq bo‘lishini orzu qiladi, “She wishes it were closer.” Uchinchi: Dan unga sinov muddatini so‘rashni maslahat beradi. E’tibor bering, “wish” bilan “she wishes it were closer”, ya’ni uchinchi shaxsda “wishes” bo‘ladi, lekin keyingi qism o‘zgarmaydi.
scenes.say: She would take the job. She wishes Dubai were closer. Dan advises her to ask for a trial period.
scenes.say_uz: U ishni olardi. U Dubay yaqinroq bo‘lishini orzu qiladi. Dan unga sinov muddatini so‘rashni maslahat beradi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: do‘stlar suhbati
board: Zoe: If you could live anywhere, where would you live?
Omar: By the sea. I wish I lived in Lisbon.
Zoe: I wouldn't. It's too hilly for me!
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Zoya va Omar xayoliy savol bilan o‘ynashmoqda: agar istalgan joyda yashay olsangiz, qayerda yashardingiz? Bunday suhbatlar ingliz tilida ko‘p uchraydi. Qisqa javoblarga e’tibor bering: “I wouldn’t”. Keyin savollarimizga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Zoe: If you could live anywhere, where would you live? Omar: By the sea. I wish I lived in Lisbon. If I did, I'd walk on the beach every morning. Zoe: I wouldn't. It's too hilly for me! I'd choose a quiet village.
scenes.say_uz: Zoya: Istalgan joyda yashay olsang, qayerda yashardingiz? Omar: Dengiz bo‘yida. Lissabonda yashasam edi. Yashasam, har ertalab plyajda sayr qilardim. Zoya: Men yo‘q. Men uchun u juda tepalikli! Tinch qishloqni tanlardim.

scenes.title: Dialog haqida savollar
board: 1) Where would Omar like to live?
2) What would he do every morning?
3) Where would Zoe choose to live?
scenes.say_native: Yana uchta savol. Birinchi: Omar qayerda yashashni xohlaydi? Ikkinchi: u har ertalab nima qilardi? Uchinchi: Zoya qayerni tanlardi? Dialogni eslang va to‘liq gaplar bilan, “would” ishlatib javob bering. Javobni dialogdagi so‘zlarga tayanib ayting, o‘zingizdan qo‘shish shart emas.
scenes.say: Answer the questions. Where would Omar like to live? What would he do every morning? Where would Zoe choose to live?
scenes.say_uz: Savollarga javob bering. Omar qayerda yashashni xohlaydi? U har ertalab nima qilardi? Zoya qayerni tanlardi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1) In Lisbon, by the sea.
2) He would walk on the beach.
3) In a quiet village.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Omar Lissabonda, dengiz bo‘yida yashashni xohlaydi. Ikkinchi: u har ertalab plyajda sayr qilgan bo‘lardi. Uchinchi: Zoya tinch qishloqni tanlagan bo‘lardi. Ko‘rdingizmi, “I wouldn’t” qisqa javob sifatida qanday ishlatilmoqda: Omar bilan rozi emasligini bildirmoqda. Bu iborani o‘zingiz ham suhbatda ishlatib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Omar would like to live in Lisbon, by the sea. He would walk on the beach every morning. Zoe would choose a quiet village.
scenes.say_uz: Omar dengiz bo‘yidagi Lissabonda yashashni xohlaydi. U har ertalab plyajda sayr qilardi. Zoya tinch qishloqni tanlardi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: I'd va wouldn't
board: I'd /aɪd/ · you'd /juːd/ · we'd /wiːd/
wouldn't /ˈwʊdnt/
What would you do? → /wɒt wʊd jə duː/

examples.t: I'd go if I could.
What would you do?

scenes.say_native: Talaffuz haqida. Og‘zaki nutqda “would” juda zaif aytiladi va ko‘pincha “’d” ga aylanadi: “I’d”, “you’d”, “we’d”. “Would” yakka o‘zi aytilsa ham “l” harfi eshitilmaydi. “Wouldn’t” — ikki bo‘g‘inli, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, “l” talaffuz qilinmaydi. Savolda “What would you do” tez aytilganda “wot wud-ya doo” kabi eshitiladi. Muhim so‘zlar, ya’ni “what” va “do”, aniq va kuchli bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: I'd go if I could. We'd stay if we had time. Wouldn't you? What would you do? I wouldn't say that.
scenes.say_uz: Qila olsam, borardim. Vaqtimiz bo‘lsa, qolardik. Siz-chi? Siz nima qilardingiz? Men buni aytmasdim.

scenes.title: Talaffuzni mashq qiling
board: If I were you, I'd go.
I wish I had more time.
What would you do if you won?
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni takrorlang. Bu mashqda ritm muhim. Shart qismini tekis ayting, so‘ng kichik pauza qiling. “I’d” ni qisqa va yengil aytib, asosiy fe’lga urg‘u bering. “Wish” da oxiridagi “sh” aniq eshitilsin. Ikki marta takrorlang va o‘zingizni tinglab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: If I were you, I'd go. I wish I had more time. What would you do if you won?
scenes.say_uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, borardim. Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa edi. Yutsangiz, nima qilardingiz?

scenes.title: Model talaffuz
board: weak 'd
stress the key verb
pause after the if clause
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Eslab qoling: “I’d” yengil, ma’noli so‘zlar kuchli. “If I were you” da urg‘u “you” ga tushishi mumkin, chunki maslahat aynan siz haqingizda. “Wish” bilan ham xuddi shunday: “I wish I had more time” da “wish” va “time” kuchli aytiladi. Shu ritmga o‘rgansangiz, nutqingiz tabiiy eshitiladi. Mashq tugadi, endi esa o‘zingiz erkin gapirish payti keldi.
scenes.say: If I were you, I'd go. I wish I had more time. What would you do if you won?
scenes.say_uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, borardim. Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa edi. Yutsangiz, nima qilardingiz?

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: nima qilardingiz?
board: 1) What would you do if you were the mayor?
2) What would you do if you found a wallet?
3) Say one wish about your life.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz gapirasiz. Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: shahar hokimi bo‘lsangiz, nima qilardingiz? Ikkinchi: ko‘chada hamyon topsangiz, nima qilardingiz? Uchinchi: hayotingiz haqida bitta istak ayting. Har bir javobda “would” yoki “wish” bo‘lsin. To‘liq gaplar bilan gapiring.
scenes.say: Now you speak. What would you do if you were the mayor of your city? What would you do if you found a wallet? Say one wish about your life.
scenes.say_uz: Endi siz gapirasiz. Shahringiz hokimi bo‘lsangiz, nima qilardingiz? Hamyon topsangiz, nima qilardingiz? Hayotingiz haqida bitta istak ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: If I were the mayor, I'd build more parks.
I'd take it to the police.
I wish I had more free time.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. “If I were the mayor, I’d build more parks and fix the roads.” “If I found a wallet, I’d take it to the police.” “I wish I had more free time.” Sizniki albatta boshqacha bo‘ladi. Shunga qaramay, tuzilishni tekshiring: “would” plus fe’l, shartda Past Simple va “wish” dan keyin ham o‘tmish shakli. Ushbu uchta tuzilishni erkin ishlata olsangiz, maqsadingizga erishdingiz.
scenes.say: If I were the mayor, I'd build more parks. If I found a wallet, I'd take it to the police. I wish I had more free time.
scenes.say_uz: Hokim bo‘lsam, ko‘proq bog‘lar qurardim. Hamyon topsam, politsiyaga olib borardim. Bo‘sh vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa edi.

scenes.title: Dars yakuni
board: Second: If + Past, would + V1
If I were you, I'd ...
I wish + Past Simple
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Real shartda “if” plus Present, “will”. Xayoliy shartda “if” plus Past Simple, “would” plus fe’l. “Be” da hamma shaxsga “were”. Maslahat uchun “If I were you, I’d...”. Hozirgi afsus uchun “wish” plus Past Simple. Shart qismida hech qachon “would” yo‘q. Bugun juda ko‘p ish qildingiz, barakalla!
scenes.say: Today you learned second conditionals, advice with if I were you, and wishes about the present. Remember: past form, present meaning. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz second conditional, if I were you bilan maslahat va hozirgi zamon haqida istaklarni o‘rgandingiz. Eslang: o‘tmish shakli, hozirgi ma’no. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: What would you do if...? × 6
Use would + V1
Past Simple after if
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: “What would you do if...?” savoliga oltita vaziyat uchun yozma javob bering. Masalan, ko‘rinmas bo‘lsangiz, millioner bo‘lsangiz, yangi shaharda yolg‘iz qolsangiz. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir javobda “I’d” yoki “I would” bor, shart qismida esa Past Simple. Keyingi darsda majburiyat, ruxsat va maslahat bildiruvchi modal fe’llarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: answer What would you do if...? for six situations. Check that you use would and the past simple. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: What would you do if...? savoliga oltita vaziyat uchun javob bering. Would va Past Simple ishlatilganini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: What would you do if...? savoliga oltita turli vaziyat uchun yozma javob bering (masalan, ko‘rinmas bo‘lsangiz, million yutsangiz, yangi shaharda yolg‘iz qolsangiz). Mezon: har bir javobda would bor, shart qismida Past Simple, kamida bitta If I were you maslahati.

quiz.q: If I ___ more money, I would buy a bigger flat.

options: If I would know, I would tell you.
If I knew, I would tell you.
If I know, I would tell you.
If I knew, I will tell you.
quiz.why_uz: Shartda Past Simple, natijada would + fe’l.
If I were you — qat’iy ibora.

quiz.q: What ___ you do if you lost your passport?
quiz.why_uz: Xayoliy savol: What would you do if + Past Simple?

options: If it rains, we'll stay in.
If it rained, we'd stay in.
If it rains, we'd stay in.
If it rained, we'll stay in.

quiz.q: I wish I ___ a car. (I don't have one.)
Give advice: 'If I ___ you, I ___ see a doctor.'
quiz.why_uz: Maslahat: if I were you, I'd + fe’l.

quiz.q: Which sentence mixes the pairs wrongly?
options: If I had time, I would help.
If I have time, I will help.
If I have time, I would help.
If it were easy, I'd try.

quiz.q: 'He never calls me.' → 'I wish he ___ me more often.'
quiz.why_uz: Boshqa odamning odatiga shikoyat: wish + would.
